div.head: I Cn 9.1
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe ofer þæne dæg hit healde, agyfe þam bisceope þæne penig ⁊ þærto XXX ⁊ þam cingce CXX scyll'.
⁊ se þe ofer þonne dæg hit healde, agife þam biscope þane peningc ⁊ þærto ðrittig penega ⁊ þam cyninge twa hundred ⁊ twentig scill'.
Qui supratenuerit, reddat episcopo denarium illum et XXX denarios addat et regi det quinquaginta (CXX) solidos.
⁊ se ðe ofer þæne dæg hit healde, agyfe þam bisceope þæne penig ⁊ þærto XXX ⁊ þam cingce CXX scyll'.
And se ðe ofer þæne dæg hit healde, agyfe þam bisceope þæne penig and þærto XXX and þam cingce CXX scyllinga.
und wer es über diesen Tag [vorent]hält, gebe dem Bischof den Pfennig und 30 (Pfennig A) dazu und dem König 120 (220 A) Schill.
and whoever withholds it beyond that day, let him give the bishop the penny and 30 (pence, A) besides, and the king 120 (220, A) shillings.
And he who withholds it beyond that date shall give the bishop the penny and 30 pence in addition, and 120 shillings to the king.
And anyone who withholds it beyond that day shall give the money and a further thirty pence to the bishop, and one hundred twenty shillings to the king.
